human_description: SOL #23 runs onto a through ball (first touch ~4.4 s) and carries it into the right channel. The MAR defender chases back, squares up at ~6.8 s and engages him 1v1 at the edge of the penalty area from 7.3 s. #23 jinks inside and out; at ~8.7 s the defender lunges and the two collide. The ball is pushed ahead past the defender, #23 gets to it first (~9.1-9.5 s) and is in sole control with the defender beaten and trailing by 9.67 s. He then drives toward the goalkeeper. DUEL WON for #23: he retains possession and the defender is left without the ball.
